  Nat.Prime p →

      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M →
                Reduction.scalarFacts p K M →
                  ∀ (bar : ↥(Reduction.loc p) →+* K)
                    (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[↥(Reduction.loc p)] Reduction.MR p M) (f : End ℤ ↥M),
                    ↑Phi ∘ₗ LinearMap.baseChange K f =
                        LinearMap.baseChange K (LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) ∘ₗ ↑Phi →
                      ∀ (u w : Reduction.MR p M) (s : ↥(Reduction.loc p)),
                        (LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) u = s • w →
                          (LinearMap.baseChange K f) (Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(Reduction.loc p)] u)) =
